id: optional — defaults to the file name without .json; must be unique across all sources
type: lesson | news | quiz | test | listening | reading | speaking | email | writing | … (free label, shown as a chip + filter)
source: claude-cowork | chatgpt | codex | … (free label; defaults to the S3 folder name the file sits in)
category: optional grouping label, e.g. daily-news, worldcup, email-check
title: Display title (English)
dateTime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM — optional; defaults to the S3 LastModified time. Any cadence works: hourly, daily, weekly, adhoc, several files in the same hour.
contentUpdatedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone — set on creation and update only after a meaningful content change; keep unchanged for no-op republishes
words: optional plain-text word list used by search
